name: The Evoker (Yorick)
creator: sauronkaiser
description:
Base champion: Yorick

Modified Skin: Default

Author: Sauronkaiser

Description: The Evoker from Minecraft.

Features:

-New model and textures.

-New full set of animations.

-New sounds.

-New particles

-New Splashart loading screen.

-New Ability icons and HUD.

-A boss from a cool Minecraft mod as the maiden.

-Absolutely no references to Age of Empires.

Lore:

The Master Evoker had been very busy lately, learning new types of magic from a new dimension he had found with a great forest in it. But he suddenly got a letter from the Chicken Jockey, finding out that some huge idiot had summoned The Wither. That monster must be stopped, as Illagers cant conquer a destroyed world. The Master Evoker sends instructions to all the Illagers under his command, and proceeds to march to battle himself to put in pratice all his new tricks.

Sources:

-Special thanks to bud for helping with the render.

-The main model of the evoker was extracted from minecraft and then modified by me.

-The model of the vex, noteblock, shovel and fangs and some other stuff is extracted directly from minecraft with some minor personal changes.

-The lich maiden references a boss from the Twilight Forest, a popular Minecraft mod. This model is NOT exctracted from the mod; it was made by myself using an image as reference and the base Minecraft skeleton. Didn't get direct permission to use this concept as it was impossible to contact the creator; contact me if theres something wrong with it.

-Sounds extracted from Minecraft.
